51455203.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human BCL6 BDB domain by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. The human BCL6 BTB domain (residues 1–120) was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip via amine coupling. The ligand was injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 nM in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20) at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 8 caption: Figure 8. X-ray structure of 25 (PDB: 7OKD, resolution 1.94 Å).
original_paragraph.Results section: Biochemical and cellular potency was maintained, and binding affinity to the BCL6 BTB domain was also confirmed by SPR (25 TR-FRET pIC50 7.58, SPR pKD 6.63).
